clues.it: Ugo era l'unica persona su un cappotto caduto.
clues.en: Ugo was the only person on a dropped coat.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Dario was beside the reception desk.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Anna was beside a persian carpet.

clues.it: Carla era esattamente una riga a nord di Sergio.
clues.en: Carla was exactly one row north of Sergio.

clues.it: Sergio era da solo in Cantina.
clues.en: Sergio was alone in the Cellar.

clues.it: Fabio era nella stessa stanza di Anna.
clues.en: Fabio was in the same room as Anna.

clues.it: Elena era nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Elena was in the same room as Dario.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Dario's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 2nd, column 7th.

steps.it: Solo Luca può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 4th, column 6th.

steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Sergio is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.
